text:
maria.g: Quick Q — where's the per-tenant / per-prefix cache hit-rate dashboard? Our alert fired twice this morning and it's not obvious which tenant/prefix triggered it :eyes:

alex.k: There's a Grafana dash for KV cache but it defaults to the cluster-aggregate view. Try this one: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kvcache/kv-prefix-cache?orgId=1 — switch the " + '"Tenant"' + " dropdown to the tenant you care about, then the panel 'prefix hitrate (1m rolling)' shows individual prefixes.

For raw Prom queries you can compute it as: 
```
rate(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])
/ rate(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])
```
then `sum(...) by (prefix, tenant)` for per-prefix-per-tenant.

josh.s: FYI the current alert sums across tenants, which makes low-volume tenants noisy. We should require a minimum request count before firing. Example alert rule I use locally:
```
expr: |
  sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (tenant) > 50 and
  (
    sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (tenant)
    /
    sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (tenant)
  ) < 0.6
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
```
This avoids pages for tenants with <50 requests in 5m.

priya: Thanks — also where's the eviction/pressure panel? I'm trying to correlate a drop in hit-rate with a surge in evictions.

alex.k: Eviction metrics are on the same KV dashboard under the 'evictions & mem' row: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kvcache/evictions-panel?orgId=1. Look at 'evictions/s by shard' and the 'cache size by prefix' heatmap. If you need a direct join, export the prefix label from the eviction panel and compare with the hitrate panel.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: kv-cache/2.14.0 → prod at 2025-02-12T08:12:34Z :rocket:

maria.g: OK that deploy lines up with the spike. Can we tune the alert sensitivity or add tenant filters so this doesn't page on small tenants?

josh.s: I'll open a PR to change the alert to require min 50 reqs/5m and bump the threshold to 55% for non-prod tenants. Will also add a note in the alert description linking to the dash and the PromQL snippet. Ping me if you want to test the rule in staging.

maria.g: thanks — please drop the dashboard link and the alert PR in the incident doc, I'll attach traces/logs once I pull them.

alex.k: Traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/search?tag=prefix (search by `prefix` tag). Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/query?q=%22kv_prefix%22%20evict — you can filter by tenant id.

priya: looping in @oncall because customer-facing pages were noisy earlier.

oncall: I'm watching the metrics, can confirm noise from low-volume tenants. Agree with the min-reqs approach. Once josh has the PR I can approve for immediate alert update.

maria.g: awesome — appreciate the quick help :pray:
